definitions.explanation: The act of consuming food and drink, often implying indulgence or a social context.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{食|く}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{好|す}き→好き：02355_suki⟧だ。
⟦{旅行|りょこう}{先|さき}→旅行先：28195_ryokousaki⟧⟦で→で：00502_de⟧{飲|の}み{食|く}い⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{楽|たの}しんだ→楽しむ：01203_tanoshimu⟧。
examples.english: I enjoyed eating and drinking at my travel destination.

examples.japanese: {飲|の}み{食|く}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧かけすぎて、⟦{貯金|ちょきん}→貯金：03497_chokin⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦できない→できる：00557_dekiru⟧。
examples.english: I spend too much on food and drink and can't save any money.

notes:
A compound of ⟦{飲|の}む→飲む：00322_nomu⟧ (to drink) and ⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧ (to eat, informal). The use of ⟦{食|く}う→食う：02657_kuu⟧ rather than ⟦{食|た}べる→食べる：00396_taberu⟧ gives this word a casual, hearty feel. Also functions as a suru verb ({飲|の}み{食|く}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {飲|の}み{食|く}い⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ — to eat and drink
- {飲|の}み{食|く}い⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{激|はげ}しい→激しい：02348_hageshii⟧ — to eat and drink a lot
- {飲|の}み{食|く}い⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦お{金|かね}→お金：00611_okane⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦かける→かける：00854_kakeru⟧ — to spend money on food and drink
- {飲|の}み{食|く}い⟦{放題|ほうだい}→放題：03151_houdai⟧ — all-you-can-eat-and-drink

REGISTER:
Informal and colloquial. Suitable for casual conversation but not for formal writing. The formal equivalent would be ⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧.

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{飲食|いんしょく}→飲食：03010_inshoku⟧ — eating and drinking (formal, used in signs and official contexts)
- ⟦{食|た}べ{歩|ある}き→食べ歩き：15117_tabearuki⟧ — food tour, eating around (walking and sampling food)
